title.narrative: The UNICEF-supported mental health service package reached 164,500 middle school students across 10 provinces. Four provinces passed EMTCT validation, and UNICEF provided direct support on community-based engagement in underperforming provinces. School-based participatory courses on road safety are being piloted with 99,225 students from 3 western provinces.
